name: adv_junction_loop_closure_cycle
source:
// Union-find loop closure: connect(a,b), connect(b,c), connect(c,a) must
// collapse to ONE node, not three, and must not double-count the flow sum.
ThermalSource S1(T = 400)
Conduction    C1(k = 10, area = 1, L = 0.1)
Conduction    C2(k = 10, area = 1, L = 0.1)
ThermalSource S2(T = 300)
connect(S1.port, C1.a)
connect(C1.b, C2.a)
connect(C2.a, C1.b)
connect(C2.b, S2.port)
q1 = C1.Q
q2 = C2.Q
tm = C1.b.T

oracle.generated_by: Rust engine 2026-10-20. The fixture's stated intent - repeated connects of the same endpoints collapse to ONE node and the flow sum is not double-counted - is now met: each connection set emits a single flow rule. The Java oracle emitted one Kirchhoff sum per connect statement and failed as overspecified. q1 = q2 = k*A*dT/L = 5000 W exactly.
